{{Top|leg}}
'''Teeda's Eyes''' was the collective name given to [[Pii III]] and [[Pii IV]]. It was a reference to [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Teeda]] of the [[Regency Worlds/Legends|Arkanis Regency]]; the lush forested [[Planet/Legends|planets]] brought to mind the green eyes of the Empress.
